feeConfigTreasuries.note: Plain Pubkey fields stored on FeeConfig (OFS-4100 §5's dev/ecosystem/infra/emergency 40/30/20/10 split, 15 bps settlement fee) — these 4 addresses do not yet have real Token-2022 accounts for the OPEN mint, so release_escrow/execute_dispute_outcome cannot actually complete until each one's ATA is created. Needed before Phase 9's escrow-lifecycle conformance proof, not before Phase 8's Stake/Cast-vote UI work.

devnet_programs.note: Deployed via `solana program deploy --url devnet` and initialized via a one-off script using the new Rust SDK's onchain::{escrow,staking,governance} builders (Phase 8's own deploy+init step, pulled forward from Phase 9's original schedule — Phase 8's app wiring needs a real devnet deployment to cut over against). FeeConfig/StakingConfig/GovernanceConfig singletons are all live: staking_config.mint = governance_config.mint = the real devnet OPEN mint above (decimals 9); staking's unbonding/slash_bps and governance's quorum/threshold/deposit/vote_lock all use OFS-4100's own recommended [PROPOSED — NEEDS SIGN-OFF] figures, not invented values. LAYOUT CHANGE: StakingConfig's flat min_stake plus special-cased min_stake_arbitrator were replaced by a per-role min_stake_by_role array ([u64; 7], indexed by Role), and the minimums are now actually enforced by `stake` and `request_unstake` — previously they were stored and read by nothing, so any amount was accepted. The already-deployed config account was rewritten in place by the program's own `migrate_staking_config` instruction (scripts/migrate-devnet-staking-config.ts) rather than being recreated, so the config PDA and both token vaults kept their addresses. Live values: 1,000 OPEN for every role except Arbitrator at 10,000 (both per OFS-4100 §4) and NotificationProvider at 5,000 (protocol-steward decision; OFS-4100 §4 amended to record it).
